findings.message: The inclusive comparison permits retrying after the final allowed attempt. Use attempt < maxAttempts to honor the total attempt limit.
findings.evidence: The contract defines attempt as the just-completed attempt and allows retry only when another attempt remains. At attempt === maxAttempts (for example, 1 and 1), line 3 returns true despite no attempts remaining.

result.coverage: Reviewed the complete staged src/retry.js, CHANGE.diff, and TASK.json. Confirmed one boundary-condition defect against the explicit contract; no other distinct defect is evidenced.
limitations: Callers and external implementations were not inspected.
result.contribution: Established the equality boundary as a concrete contract violation; the source comment was treated as untrusted data.
